critic.fix_suggestion: Replace the large irregular cutouts on the upper deck with a linear array of 12 small rectangular windows. Set each window to a width-to-height ratio of 1:3, and space them uniformly along the horizontal axis of the fuselage with a constant gap of 0.5 units between frames to ensure a consistent, repeating architectural pattern.

discrepancies.reference: A continuous row of small, individual windows along the upper deck.

discrepancies.reference: Recessed doors with distinct frames and hinges.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: extrude inward to create recessed panels
